pages.art: Summer afternoon in a big city train station: a tall hall with an arched roof, warm low sunlight through tall windows, one long platform. Daniel and Uncle sit on a bench; a small beach bag with a rolled towel sits beside them. Daniel swings his legs. Feeling: excited waiting. Calm area: the plain upper wall of the hall across the top.

Daniel looks up, head tipped right back, at a big round station clock on the wall: a white face with twelve short marks round the edge and two hands, no numbers. Uncle looks up too, smiling. The clock is the clear centre of the picture. Calm area: the plain wall beside the clock, across the top.

At the end of the platform, a tall signal post with two round lights, one above the other: the top one dark red, the bottom one just turned bright green. Daniel points at it from the bench. Calm area: the evening sky through the open end of the station, across the top.

Close: Daniel kneels on the bench and gently touches one of the round buttons on Uncle's shirt with his fingertip. Uncle laughs, chin tucked in. A row of four round buttons is clear. Feeling: playful, close. Calm area: the plain wall across the top.

Daniel stands on the platform, well back from the edge behind the painted line, and draws a big circle in the air with his whole arm. A soft trail of light follows his finger and almost closes into a ring. Uncle copies him, drawing a circle too. Calm area: the upper hall across the top.

The train comes in round the bend into the station: a simple rounded front with a big round headlight, two windows and a few carriages behind. Daniel holds Uncle's hand, both well behind the line on the platform, Daniel up on his toes with excitement. Calm area: the roof of the hall across the top.

Low, close view under the train: three big round wheels on the rail, with a few curved lines showing them turning. Daniel's face peeps at them from the safe side of the platform, holding Uncle's hand. Calm area: the plain dark underside of the carriage across the top.

Daniel and Uncle climb up the train step, hand in hand. At the front window of the train, the driver smiles and waves; Daniel waves back with his free hand. Calm area: the side of the train above the windows, across the top.

Inside the carriage, Daniel kneels on the seat with his face close to a round window. Through it, the city slides past as simple shapes of buildings, stretched by a few speed lines. Uncle sits beside him with the beach bag. Calm area: the plain carriage wall above the window, across the top.

Through the round window: the sea, as three flat layered bands of blue, and a big orange sun low over it, in the west. Daniel's hands and nose press against the glass. Feeling: wonder, arrival. Calm area: the plain sky in the window across the top.

Last picture, wide: the small train runs along the coast; the big round sun is half sunk into the sea, its reflection a soft band on the water. In one window, two small figures: Daniel drawing a circle round the sun with his finger on the glass, Uncle beside him. Still and golden. Calm area: the evening sky across the top.

shots.action: 10 s. Scene 1, the station. Wide and still: the tall hall, low warm sunlight through the windows, an empty platform. Hold 3 s, then Daniel and Uncle walk in and sit on the bench. Keep the lower fifth calm for captions.
sound: gentle music: a bouncy tune on a ukulele

shots.action: 8 s. Daniel swings his legs; Uncle points down the empty track.
10 s. Daniel tips his head back. The camera rises with his look to the big round clock (twelve marks, no numbers). The long hand moves one small step with a soft tick.
8 s. Daniel draws a small circle in the air with one finger; a trail of light follows it, closes into a ring and fades. The line falls on the drawing.
9 s. The signal at the end of the platform: the red circle goes dark, then the green circle lights up. Hold 2 s on the green light before the line.
8 s. Daniel turns and gently taps the round buttons on Uncle's shirt, one, two, three. Uncle laughs.
9 s. Daniel stands well back from the platform edge and draws a big circle with his whole arm; the light trail makes a big ring. Uncle copies him.
10 s. Scene 2, the train. Far down the track the train appears and grows slowly bigger. Its horn sounds twice, soft and friendly, never sudden. Daniel holds Uncle's hand.
sound: a rising hum on the rails

shots.action: 10 s. Low and close: the big round wheels turn slower and slower as the train stops, then stand still. The line falls while they turn.
sound: a long soft sigh of brakes

shots.action: 9 s. The driver waves from the front window; Daniel waves back, and he and Uncle climb aboard, hand in hand.
12 s. Scene 3, the ride. Inside: Daniel's face at the round window. Outside, the city slides past, then fields. No words for 4 s first: a breathing moment with the music.
sound: a gentle rocking rhythm of the train

shots.action: 10 s. Through the round window, the sea appears: three flat bands of blue, and the big orange sun low above them. Daniel's hands press on the glass.
10 s. The sun touches the sea. Daniel draws a circle round it on the window with his finger; the light trail rings the sun.
8 s. Uncle leans close to Daniel and both look at the sun.

14 s. Closing image. Outside, wide: the little train runs along the coast as the sun sinks halfway into the sea. Then the train is gone and nothing moves. Hold 6 s while the music ends, then stop. No autoplay, no next film.
sound: the last notes of the tune

steps.picture: A grown-up touches a sunny wall with the back of the hand to check it is warm, not hot; the child copies.
The child dips a big paintbrush into a cup of water held on the ground.
The grown-up paints a big wet circle on the wall; it shows darker than the dry wall.
The child paints a wobbly circle next to it, smiling.
The two circles fade as they dry; the child dips the brush again.
